en.headline: HKMA keeps base rate at 4 per cent after Fed holds rates steady
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said the Federal Reserve’s decision to leave the federal funds target range unchanged was in line with market expectations and local markets continued to operate orderly.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on 30 July that it would keep the Base Rate unchanged at 4 per cent following the US Federal Reserve’s decision to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.5–3.75 per cent.

The Fed’s policy decision, announced earlier the same day Hong Kong time, was in line with market expectations. The accompanying statement noted that economic activity was expanding at a solid pace and the labour market remained stable, while inflation stayed elevated.

Under the Linked Exchange Rate System, Hong Kong dollar interbank rates generally track their US dollar counterparts. The HKMA said Hong Kong’s monetary and financial markets had continued to operate in an orderly manner and that it would keep monitoring developments closely to maintain monetary and financial stability. The public was advised to manage interest-rate risks carefully when making decisions on property, investment or borrowing.

zh.headline: 金管局維持基本利率4厘 緊隨聯儲局按兵不動
zh.dek: 金管局表示聯儲局維持聯邦基金利率目標範圍的決定符合市場預期，本港貨幣及金融市場繼續有序運作。
body: 香港金融管理局今日公布，在美國聯邦儲備局決定維持聯邦基金利率目標範圍於3.5至3.75厘後，本港基本利率維持於4厘不變。
聯儲局於今日稍早（香港時間）公布的決定符合市場預期。會議聲明指經濟活動以穩健步伐擴張，勞工市場保持穩定，但通脹仍然偏高。
在聯繫匯率制度下，港元銀行同業拆息大致跟隨美元息率。金管局表示，本港貨幣及金融市場繼續有序運作，並會密切監察市場發展，維持貨幣及金融穩定。公眾在作出置業、投資或借貸決定時，應審慎管理利率風險。
